options.text: No. Heat this strong destroys every living thing.
options.feedback: A fair guess, because boiling water kills most living things we know. Look at what is really in the spring.

options.text: Yes, but only large animals with thick skin.
options.feedback: Size and thick skin do not protect a body from water near boiling point.

options.text: Yes. Organisms made of one cell live in it.
Yes, but only plants, because their roots stay cool.
options.feedback: Plants are made of many cells, and they do not fill these springs.
